definitions.explanation: The country on the southern portion of the Korean Peninsula. Officially the Republic of Korea.

examples.japanese: {韓国|かんこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have been to South Korea.

examples.japanese: {韓国|かんこく}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧で、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: More people have started studying Korean, influenced by Korean dramas.

notes:
{韓国|かんこく} refers to South Korea, a country on the southern half of the Korean Peninsula and one of Japan's closest neighbors geographically and culturally. Korean pop culture, food, and language study are widely popular in Japan.

NAMING: {韓国|かんこく} is the standard Japanese name for South Korea. The formal name is {大韓民国|だいかんみんこく}.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{韓国語|かんこくご}→韓国語：25419_kankokugo⟧: Korean language
- {韓国人|かんこくじん}: Korean person
- ⟦{韓国料理|かんこくりょうり}→韓国料理：25590_kankokuryouri⟧: Korean cuisine
- {韓国|かんこく}ドラマ: Korean drama (K-drama)

RELATED WORDS:
- {北朝鮮|きたちょうせん}: North Korea
- {朝鮮半島|ちょうせんはんとう}: Korean Peninsula
- ソウル: Seoul
